column3: Manami Route ・ The Lonely Road Home
Finish classes, leave school, go home.
Just another regular day for a regular "High School Student".
But today was... just a little different.
What was different?  Well, it started when Manami, walking next to me, said...
Kyou-chan, good work today.
The usual after school scene-- or so I thought.
Um, we can't go home together today.
Oh, really? Do you have something to do?
Geez, if you nod like that, your head is going to fall off, Manami.
You don't have to answer so frantically.
So um, that thing I have to do... it's probably going to take some time.
I see. Sounds like a big deal. Want me to help?
No no, I'm fine.  I can do it by myself but... I think I'll be home later than usual. So, Kyou-chan, can you go home ahead of me... please?
Oh, well sure I guess...
And just like that...
Today I was going home alone.
I mean, I've taken this same road home so many times I can't even count, but...
Going home alone like this hasn't happened in quite a while.
Speaking of which, Manami said she would be home late, but I wonder if she phoned home about it.
She said she's prone to losing her cellphone, and so insists on not carrying one around...
The Tamura family would definitely worry if their daughter came home late.
Guess I'll just head over and let them know?
But, you know, if she already told her family, I might just be meddlesome to them...
--Oh?
Nice Timing! There's that bald head I know so well, walking my way!
'Sup !
Ah, 'sup bro!
You came at the perfect time, Rock. Right now I've got very important assignment for you.
What?! That's a serious responsibility!
Good ol' Middle Schoolers.  You guys really understand the importance of being responsible.
Listen up. You must remember exactly, word for word, what I say.
Yeah yeah yeah!!
Okay. Here we go. Your sister...
M-My sister?!
Had something come up that is completely unavoidable.
...*gulp*
Today, she will... be home late
My sister... is coming home... late!
Yup. Be sure to tell your Mom, alright?
What the heck, man!  This isn't even important at all!
No, it's reaaally important, you know?
Whoa...
Oooh, it's been so long, this booth feeling...
Be sure and tell your mom, Rock.
Yeah, I got it Bro! Leave it to me!
Gotcha!  Don't let me down!
And thus ends my role in all this.
Now Manami hopefully won't get yelled at for coming home late.
Ah! Wait, bro!
I wanna ask you something.
Ask me something?  Don't tell me it's some bittersweet teen coming-of-age romance story? Yuck, no thanks.  Leave me out of it.
The heck?  No, no, it's about my sister!
About Manami?
*sigh*...
What is that sigh?  It doesn't suit you at all.
I don't think I particularly like being stared at by this bald head of yours.
Recently, all my sister talks about around the house is you.
...only about me?
Uhh, well actually she's always talked about you! But, this is like different, I guess?
Hmm...
I was just wondering what it could mean.
Manami only talks about me... I could imagine it. But, something seems off?  I mean, even someone as dull and dense as Rock can tell?
What, you mean Manami's like... even acting strange at home?
Tell me, bro.  I have no clue. Gram and Gramps seems to be having fun.
Her only talking about me is nothing new. But not just that, something seems particularly odd as of late.  So, I guess...
L-like, I love him sooo much I want to be together everyday, or,
I love him sooo much I want to marry him, or...
So basically, about 【Engagement】?
...Engagement...
Hey bro, what did you just say?  En, en?
Oh, uh, no-nothing.
It's not "nothing", right?
It's complicated...
Hey, bro. Imma ask you one more time.  What did you say?
...Yeah, yeah. Engagement, is what I said.
At that time, I said that my feelings for Manami were enough for an Engagement.
Yeah, girls, especially Manami, always think that dating equals getting married. She's so old fashioned.
Well, I didn't mean it in a bad way...
Ah, I just can't say it right.
Hmm, how should I explain this to Rock.
I was just speaking metaphorically...
Whoa, whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa!
Whoa?
Ooooooooh!  That's soooo awesoooome!
H-Hey, hey wait a minute.
Seriously?!  Frickin' Sweet!  You for real?!
Hey, Rock, just hold on one second. I said wait!
Bro! You mean you're really totally for sure gunna be my totally really seriously for sure brother?!
Like I said, it's complicated!
I gotta go tell everyone!
You idiot! Don't exaggerate!
Crap, Gramps said we were running low on Sugar... think we can make it in time?
What's with the sudden talk about sugar?!
What're you talking about, bro?  We gotta make some Kohaku Manju! That requires lots of sugar!
I would expect nothing less from the son of a Sweets Chef! But wait, hold on a sec. You misunderstood me.  This isn't something you should
be telling your gran-
See ya, bro!  I'm going straight home!
L-Let me at least finish talking!
Thanks a lot!  Sis didn't mention anything about this, so we have a lot of preparations to catch up on!
P-Preparations!?  Rock waaaaaait!
Wait... please...
Man, there's just nothing I can do about that kid.
And just like that, only a mere few hours since we parted ways, there was a terrible, terrible monster waiting for me at home.
I, uh... this is...
Umm, you know, it's like...
The wooden box sitting in front of my parents was full of Tamura Specialty Kohaku Manju...
Very carefully, both Manami's name and my name were burned into them. Looking at it, they were prepared for this!?
Well well, I already knew.
Huh?  What did you already know?
Eh?  Before this even arrived at out house, the neighbor told me.
N-N-Neighbor?  Must have been Rock...
Ahh, but it sure is a good thing our house is so close to Manami's. Since you'll be the new owner of the Sweets Shop, you can come and go at a
moment's notice.
W-W-W-Why would I be the owner of a Sweets Shop!?
Huh? You're going to make Manami your wife, so isn't that how things will be?
Ugh, that was just a misunderstanding--
...Kyousuke.
You're properly prepared for this, right? I won't let you just laugh it off as a joke.
Crap!  Dad's eyes is locked into serious mode. No choice but to go through with it... right?
W, Welcome home...
As always, those eyes that despise her brother as though he weren't her brother at all.
Tch, what's with her? What did I ever do to be hated so much?
Ah, nope, I was wrong.
Kirino isn't looking at me, she's looking at the Kohaku Manju.
I see.
H-Hey...!
Don't talk to me.  I'm busy.
Dad, Mom, I don't need dinner tonight.
Oh, really?
Yeah. I don't have the appetite. I'll just eat some yoghurt, okay?
Take care of your health.
Thanks. I'm going to my room.
This is like some kind of Galge.
Galge?
Eh, sorry. I just thought that to myself just now
You saying you think of my sister like a game?
What?  No, no. I just misspoke.
Do you mean it's like a realistic game? Or, are you saying that real life is like a game?
Real life's like a game?
That's just, the word "Galge" just popped into my head, is all.
But, even so, I don't mean it like Manami is a character in a game.
Plain, wearing glasses, airhead, always by my side, old childhood friend, this is such a stereotypical setting!
...and yet, is that a bad thing?
My sister talking about you, that's real, bro! Saying it's like a game...
Okay okay!  You misunderstood, Rock.
Pssh, whatever man!
Hey, hey, wait Rock!
Ahh, why can't I just explain things properly?
You just go off and I can't even keep up with you.
You saying you think of my sister like a game?
No, I don't think that, at all. Did I give off that impression?
Manami...  Manami herself... I wonder.
Ahh, I just don't get it.
Maybe what Rock is saying, maybe just a little, is true
Manami and I... something is definitely off right now.
...Probably.
What?  No, no, not even close.  Rock, are you sure you're not just imagining it?
Ugh, this is turning into something way more difficult that it should be.  I gotta dodge this bullet somehow!
Aahh, no way!
Wha-!?
Bro, you're so dumb!  That's not going to work, it's never going to work at all!
Huh!?  How am I dumb?  How?
Bro, you don't realize it just by looking at my sister?
...Huh?
Me, I can tell.  I can see it in my sister's eyes
That's 【The Eyes of the Love Stricken Maiden】
W H A T D I D Y O U S A Y?
Hey, Rock.  What did you just say with that stupid bald head of yours?
W-W-What did you say?
Like I said, The Eyes of the Love Stricken Maiden!
M-Maiden... W-Where did you learn that phrase?
Don't treat me like an idiot! I'm serious!
You for real? If you're serious, than this is gonna be a big problem.
Ugh, just, whatever!
The Eyes of the Love Stricken Maiden...
Saying it to myself is doubly embarrassing.
Rock isn't even here and that phrase is still stuck in my head.
Manami, a love stricken maiden?
I can't say I don't believe it
But maybe, even just a little, what Rock is saying is true...
Manami and I... something is definitely off right now.
...Probably.
